Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
Upper Text: When effects trash this card from the security stack, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -8000 DP for the turn.

[When Digivolving] By trashing your top security card, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Kentaurosmon] or [Mitamamon] in its name or the [CS] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
